run_route_guide_client: run the gRPC route guide client that calls all four RPC types on localhost:50051
create_route_note: create a RouteNote message with a text message and latitude/longitude location
get_feature_at_point: get a single feature from the route guide server at a given latitude and longitude
list_features_in_rectangle: list all features within a rectangular geographic bounding box on the route guide server
record_route_trip: record a route by sending random points to the server and receive a trip summary with distance and time
